We are seeing a large number of cars parking in the upper lot or blocking the busses which is causing traffic flow issuesWe appreciate your cooperation!If you have any questions or concerns, please call the office! We are happy to help!

Contact the office with questions.

These glasses and cases are donated all over the world to children who are in need. The lenses and frames from the donated glasses are modified to meet individual children's eye needs. Every year, Oxford Lions Club collects and sends 900-plus pairs of glasses to children in need!Please send any glasses donations to Betsy Beaton (Marshall Elementary School) or Shaunna Tafelski (Board Office) by the beginning of December.
